_CRITICAL_DISCREPANCY.finding: Addendum #1's narrative change list (section 5.01) names only FIVE reissued sheets: C1, GD, G0-00, LS1-10, A1-20. Seven sheets were actually reissued -- A2-10 and A10-30 are omitted from that list.
_CRITICAL_DISCREPANCY.CORRECTION_2026_07_31: An earlier version of this entry claimed the two sheets were reissued with no announcement anywhere, and that only a folder listing plus overlay could catch them. That was wrong. The REVISED G0-00 cover sheet carries an updated INDEX OF DRAWINGS with a new column headed '2026.05.06 - ADDENDUM #1', and that column is dotted on all SEVEN reissued sheets, A2-10 and A10-30 included. The revision delta on G0-00 is that index. So the information WAS disclosed in the contract documents -- just not in the addendum's narrative.
_CRITICAL_DISCREPANCY.why_it_still_matters: The addendum narrative and the revised drawing index disagree with each other. A bidder working from the addendum text alone gets five sheets; a bidder cross-checking the revised cover sheet index gets seven. Both A2-10 and A10-30 carry real scope changes (locker re-layout, new filler keynote, restroom partition changes). That is a live source of bid-scope variance between subcontractors.
_CRITICAL_DISCREPANCY.pm_action: Confirm with KNIT that section 5.01's list is simply incomplete and that all seven sheets were intentionally reissued. Worth noting in the subcontract that the revised drawing index on G0-00 governs the list of current sheet revisions.

documents_requiring_a_fire_alarm: Clarification No.1 RFI #4, answered by KNIT 05/05/26: 'Fire Alarm required per code. See Sheet E3-00 for tie-in to existing FAP at existing High School.' Per PM's own 07.31.26 ruling, RFI responses issued with the Addendum ARE contract documents that hold the subcontractor responsible.
Sheet E3-00 (Overall Technology Site Plan, Vol 2 p.37) keynote 5: 'ROUTE TO LOCATION OF EXISTING FIRE ALARM PANEL IN OFFICE' -- the tie-in the RFI points to actually exists on the drawing.

Sheet E0-01 (Electrical General Notes, Vol 2 p.24) note 81: 'FIRE ALARM SYSTEM. CONTRACTOR SHALL PROVIDE DEVICES, CONDUIT, WIRES AND CABLE AS DIRECTED BY...' plus note 80 'FIRE ALARM' and conduit color-code 'E. FIRE ALARM - RED'.
documents_stating_no_fire_alarm: Sheet LS1-10 (Code and Exiting Plan), ADDENDUM #1 revision dated 05.06.26, Code Analysis block: 'FIRE ALARM: NO'. Same block also lists 'AUTOMATIC SPRINKLER SYSTEM: NO' and 'STATE FIRE MARSHAL: SFM (NAC 477: NEVADA STATE FIRE MARSHAL)'. Occupancy Group E, Type VB, occupant load 110.
_DOCUMENT_EVIDENCE_ON_RECORD.exposure: Three-to-one against the no-fire-alarm reading, and the one supporting document is a code-analysis summary block rather than a scope drawing. If RFP-103's subcontract excludes the fire alarm and the State Fire Marshal requires it on a Group E occupancy, this becomes a change order on a life-safety system during construction.
_DOCUMENT_EVIDENCE_ON_RECORD.required_action_either_way: Whichever way this lands, the documents must be reconciled rather than left contradictory. If NO fire alarm: obtain an ASI or written clarification voiding RFI #4, E0-01 note 81 and E3-00 keynote 5, and write an explicit exclusion into RFP-103's Attachment A. If fire alarm IS required: LS1-10's code block needs correcting and RFP-103 carries the system including tie-in to the existing High School FAP.
